items.title: Cellista By Zoya opens studios from AED 626K in Madinat Al Mataar
items.summary: Off-plan studio apartments from 352 sq ft with handover in Q3 2029. Developer plan is 20% on booking, 28% during construction, 10% on handover and 42% over 60 months after handover.

items.title: Merdan Residences launches studios from AED 668K in Dubai Sports City
items.summary: Off-plan studio to two-bedroom apartments from 393 sq ft with handover in Q4 2027. Three payment plans are published (30/70, 40/60 and 50/50), so no single plan is recorded.
